description: This file defines the OpenClawChatTransport protocol, an enum for chat transport events, and default implementations for protocol methods that mostly throw not supported errors, providing an interface for chat transport operations such as message sending, session management, and health checks.

classes.name: OpenClawChatTransport
classes.description: A protocol defining asynchronous methods for chat transport functionalities, along with default stub implementations that throw errors indicating unsupported operations.

methods.name: requestHistory
methods.description: Asynchronously requests chat history for a given session key.

methods.name: listModels
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a list of available chat models.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message with optional attachments within a session.

methods.name: abortRun
methods.description: Aborts an ongoing chat run for a specific session.

methods.name: listSessions
methods.description: Lists chat sessions, optionally limited by a maximum number.

methods.name: setSessionModel
methods.description: Sets or updates the model used in a chat session.

methods.name: setSessionThinking
methods.description: Configures the thinking level of a chat session.

methods.name: requestHealth
methods.description: Checks the health status of the chat transport.

methods.name: events
methods.description: Provides an asynchronous stream of chat transport events.

methods.name: setActiveSessionKey
methods.description: Sets the current active session key.
